architecture.entry: src/main.js owns boot, menu actions and coordinated shutdown
architecture.engine: src/core/Engine.js owns renderer, one RAF, adaptive resolution, input and bounded substeps
architecture.simulation: src/game/Game.js owns state, spawning, swept collision, scoring and campaign progression
architecture.presentation: Game.lateUpdate runs camera, effects, projectile uploads and DOM HUD once per rendered frame
architecture.world: Level produces seeded data; Fortress streams merged geometry with at most two chunk builds per rendered frame
architecture.visibility: CombatVisibility projects target centers with a 4 percent screen-edge margin. Marker sightlines honor solid cover using parallel orthographic or perspective rays.
architecture.render: RenderPass, HDR-threshold bloom, ACES/sRGB output and combined FXAA/chroma/vignette/scanlines
architecture.audio: Web Audio synthesis and a lookahead music scheduler

resource_ownership.application: Lifetime owns event subscriptions and cancellable waits; shutdown disposes actors before shared caches.
resource_ownership.shared: Materials and Textures own reusable materials/textures; enemy and pickup caches live until application shutdown.
resource_ownership.instances: Fortress owns streamed geometry; actors own private geometry and flash/core materials; pools own their instance buffers.
resource_ownership.new_markers: HUD owns and reuses at most twelve DOM marker nodes, hides them on reset and removes them on disposal.
resource_ownership.visibility_queries: Reusable scalar/vector/box scratch storage; marker queries do not mutate gate collision caches or retain actor references.

known_tradeoffs: Procedural texture anisotropy still changes only after reload; other quality budgets switch live.
Partial constructor failures can leave allocations outside the outer shutdown owner.
Simulation uses up to four bounded variable substeps, not a fixed-step accumulator.
Projectile tests use moving enemy current centers; moving gates have previous/current face sweeps.

Viewport eligibility is based on the target center or boss impact point, not GPU occlusion queries. Physical cover still blocks bullets; HUD marker sightlines separately respect approaching walls/gates.
The twelve-marker limit bounds DOM work; radar still shows farther contacts.
No new independent critic scores were assigned during this maintenance pass.

performance_targets.memory: Require a stable post-warm-up geometry/texture/GPU-memory plateau across ten retries, quality switching and a complete campaign.
performance_targets.measurement_limits: Current render-call/triangle counts are controlled 1280x720 scene snapshots, not sustained FPS or GPU byte measurements.
